fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $54,500 for a Stand-Alone Business and $27,200 for a Micro Market Business. Reduced fees apply for existing franchisees opening additional locations (as low as $13,600 for Micro Market or $27,200 for Stand-Alone on 7th+ unit). A 10% discount is offered to honorably discharged U.S. veterans via the IFA VetFran Program. During fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, fees actually ranged from $5,450 (ARCPoint franchisee incentive program) to $54,500. An additional Initial Training Fee of $7,500 is required. MUD Agreement fees are calculated as the full Initial Franchise Fee for the first unit plus 50% for each additional committed unit; MUD Fees ranged from $5,450 to $40,875 in the last fiscal year. All fees are fully earned upon payment with no refunds.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an Initial Franchise Fee of $54,500 for a Stand-Alone Business and $27,200 for a Micro Market Business when you sign the Franchise Agreement. ... During our last fiscal year, which ended on December 31, 2025, the Initial Franchise Fees ranged from to $5,450 (for an ARCPoint franchisee incentive program), to $54,500 and our MUD Fees ranged from $5,450 to $40,875.
